title: Hostility Detection Dataset in Hindi
benchmark_measurement: Hate speech detection targeting specific groups based on their religious beliefs.
findings: The paper developed a dataset for hostility detection in Hindi, which defines hate speech as posts targeting groups based on characteristics including religious beliefs. Analysis of the collected data revealed that negative and offensive posts against Muslims were a visible component of the hostile content.
